'''Karoliina Honkala''' (born 1973) is a Finnish chemist who is a professor at the [[University of Jyväskylä]]. Her research considers heterogeneous and electro-catalysis. She was awarded the 2015 Berzelius Award of the Nordic Catalysis Society and elected to the [[Finnish Academy of Science and Letters]] in 2022.

== Academic career ==
Honkala was born in [[Kuusamo]]. She was a doctoral student in computational chemistry at the [[University of Oulu]]. Her doctoral research involved ''[[Ab initio]]'' studies of oxygen, carbon monoxide and nitrogen monoxide on metal (Al(111) and Pd(111)) surfaces.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Ab initio studies of O, O[sub2], CO and NO on Al(111) and Pd(111) surfaces {{!}} WorldCat.org |url=https://www.worldcat.org/title/58342798 |access-date=2022-12-09 |website=www.worldcat.org |language=en}}</ref> Honkala was then made a research professor at the [[Technical University of Denmark]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Four top scientists from the University of Jyväskylä chosen as new members of the Finnish Academy of Science and Letters |url=https://www.jyu.fi/en/current/archive/2020/09/four-top-scientists-from-the-university-of-jyvaskyla-chosen-as-new-members-of-the-finnish-academy-of-science-and-letters |access-date=2022-12-09 |website=Jyväskylän yliopisto |language=en}}</ref> She moved to the [[Academy of Finland]] in 2005, where she worked as a postdoctoral researcher.<ref name="Nimitys">[https://www.jyu.fi/ajankohtaista/arkisto/2017/04/tiedote-2017-04-11-09-22-54-040493 Karoliina Honkala kemian professoriksi] Jyväskylän yliopisto. 2017. Viitattu 12.4.2017. {{Archive url|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170412224718/https://www.jyu.fi/ajankohtaista/arkisto/2017/04/tiedote-2017-04-11-09-22-54-040493|date=2017-04-12}}</ref>

== Research and career ==
In 2006, Honkala moved to the [[University of Jyväskylä]]. That year she was made a docent in physical chemistry. She was made a professor of Computational Nanocatalysis in 2016. Her research considers surface science and catalysis. She has focused on the heterogeneous catalysis of hydrocarbonsl,<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Bligaard |first=Thomas |last2=Honkala |first2=Karoliina |last3=Logadottir |first3=Ashildur |last4=Nørskov |first4=Jens K. |last5=Dahl |first5=Søren |last6=Jacobsen |first6=Claus J. H. |date=2003-09-01 |title=On the Compensation Effect in Heterogeneous Catalysis |url=https://pubs.acs.org/doi/10.1021/jp034447g |journal=The Journal of Physical Chemistry B |language=en |volume=107 |issue=35 |pages=9325–9331 |doi=10.1021/jp034447g |issn=1520-6106|url-access=subscription }}</ref> catalysis on the surface of substances and electro-catalysis.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=A significant supercomputing grant for investigations of atomically precise nanocatalysts |url=https://www.eurekalert.org/news-releases/562134 |access-date=2022-12-10 |website=EurekAlert! |language=en}}</ref>

Whilst her initial research involved improving catalytic activity, she has made considerable efforts to improve selectivity for specific reactions.<ref name=":1" /> She has mainly considered transition metals, nanostructure surfaces and nano clusters.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Researchers discover how a nanocatalyst works at the atomic level |url=https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2019/05/190528120453.htm |access-date=2022-12-10 |website=ScienceDaily |language=en}}</ref> She has developed several computational strategies, including [[density functional theory]] and [[Monte Carlo method]]s.<ref name="HS">Helena Kinnunen: [http://www.hs.fi/ihmiset/art-2000004011428.html Filosofian maisteri Karoliina Honkala...] ''Helsingin Sanomat'' 16.11.2001. (Maksullinen artikkeli) Viitattu 12.4.2017.</ref><ref>{{Cite journal |last=Chun |first=Hee-Joon |last2=Apaja |first2=Vesa |last3=Clayborne |first3=Andre |last4=Honkala |first4=Karoliina |last5=Greeley |first5=Jeffrey |date=2017-06-02 |title=Atomistic Insights into Nitrogen-Cycle Electrochemistry: A Combined DFT and Kinetic Monte Carlo Analysis of NO Electrochemical Reduction on Pt(100) |url=https://pubs.acs.org/doi/10.1021/acscatal.7b00547 |journal=ACS Catalysis |language=en |volume=7 |issue=6 |pages=3869–3882 |doi=10.1021/acscatal.7b00547 |issn=2155-5435}}</ref>

== Academic service ==
Honkala has served as President of the Finnish Catalyst Association.<ref name="Nimitys" /> She has represented Finland on the Council of the European Federation for Catalysis.<ref name="Nimitys" /> She was awarded the 2015 Berzelius Award of the Nordic Catalysis Society and was elected to the [[Finnish Academy of Science and Letters]] in 2022.<ref name=":0" />
